mapper.select: SELECT a.org10_role_stamp_id AS role_stamp_id , a.org10_stamp_id AS stamp_id , a.org10_org_code_id AS org_code_id , f_org_nm(a.org10_org_code_id, f_sysdate()) AS org_name , a.org10_use_yn AS use_yn FROM org10_role_stamp a WHERE a.org10_stamp_id = #{stampId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM apr10_stamp s WHERE s.apr10_stamp_id = a.org10_stamp_id AND s.apr10_company_id = #{companyId})

SELECT a.org10_role_stamp_id AS role_stamp_id , a.org10_stamp_id AS stamp_id , a.org10_org_code_id AS org_code_id , f_org_nm(a.org10_org_code_id, f_sysdate()) AS org_name , a.org10_use_yn AS use_yn FROM org10_role_stamp a WHERE a.org10_role_stamp_id = #{roleStampId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO org10_role_stamp (org10_role_stamp_id, org10_stamp_id, org10_org_code_id, org10_use_yn) SELECT #{r.roleStampId}, #{r.stampId}, #{r.orgCodeId}, COALESCE(#{r.useYn}, 'true') WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM apr10_stamp s WHERE s.apr10_stamp_id = #{r.stampId} AND s.apr10_company_id = #{companyId})
mapper.update: UPDATE org10_role_stamp SET org10_stamp_id = #{r.stampId}, org10_org_code_id = #{r.orgCodeId}, org10_use_yn = COALESCE(#{r.useYn}, org10_use_yn) WHERE org10_role_stamp_id = #{r.roleStampId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM apr10_stamp s WHERE s.apr10_stamp_id = org10_stamp_id AND s.apr10_company_id = #{companyId})
